title: Baseline water stress (Aqueduct 4.0)

variable.name: bws_score
variable.meaning: Baseline water stress: ratio of total water withdrawals to available renewable surface and groundwater supply, as a 0–5 score of the sub-basin it belongs to (higher = more competition for water). Category labels give the withdrawal-to-supply ratio band.

nativeResolution: HydroBASINS level-6 sub-basins split by admin-1 boundaries (Aqueduct 4.0 units)

aggregation.toRes6: Each cell takes the Aqueduct unit polygon containing its centre (no averaging or splitting of the index).

missingData: No row: the cell centre is outside every Aqueduct unit (sea). Null value with bws_label 'No Data': Aqueduct publishes no score for that basin.
caveats: A basin-level risk index, not a measured water volume: it cannot be reduced by a project's water use or turned into available supply.
Every cell in a basin repeats the same score; neighbouring cells are not independent observations.
'Arid and Low Water Use' basins are scored 5 by Aqueduct; read the label as well as the score.
